## v0.1

2026-11-26

{: .warning }
This release has **breaking changes**, marked with ⚠ below. Check them before upgrading.

### Features
{: .no_toc }

  - ⚠ **Breaking change:**{: .text-red-300 } YAC_MCP_ALLOW (helm `allow`) replaces YAC_MCP_READ_ONLY (`readOnly`) ([1d400d8](https://github.com/yac-vays/mcp/commit/1d400d8))
  - helm chart ([cc76fd8](https://github.com/yac-vays/mcp/commit/cc76fd8))
  - MCP gateway for YAC backends ([9902148](https://github.com/yac-vays/mcp/commit/9902148))

### Fixes
{: .no_toc }

  - a refresh sends the scopes the login granted ([8e8c073](https://github.com/yac-vays/mcp/commit/8e8c073))
  - logs say what the IdP granted at a login and which refresh of it failed ([9607435](https://github.com/yac-vays/mcp/commit/9607435))
  - a write whose answer got lost is checked against the stored entity ([d543252](https://github.com/yac-vays/mcp/commit/d543252))
  - read_entity reports the limit usage and the schema for an edit ([5c9afb7](https://github.com/yac-vays/mcp/commit/5c9afb7))
  - log a rejected client metadata document as a warning (e.g. no egress to its host) ([e6b97ae](https://github.com/yac-vays/mcp/commit/e6b97ae))
  - follow the latest YAC/VAYS changes ([6ef0c67](https://github.com/yac-vays/mcp/commit/6ef0c67))
